rules.rationale: Android 16 first returns persist.sys.locale, then bst.locale, and only then runs the current upstream SIM-country locale resolution. This preserves the A13 no-SIM result while retaining current permission and telephony-feature checks and a functional platform fallback.
rules.necessity: Required because the virtual guest may not have modem-backed SIM records when locale is queried.
rules.performance: Two property reads precede the existing method; no additional Binder, database or network work.
rules.security: The current privileged permission and feature enforcement remain active, unlike the commented-out A13 tail.
validation_evidence: Current PhoneInterfaceManager lines 8136-8149 implement the ordered persist.sys.locale/bst.locale path. Component branch aosp16-bst-merge is clean; runtime locale fallback remains pending.
